text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On one cold winter's night, with the
Arima Kinen
almost upon us... A rustling
sound startles me out
of my sleep. I
open my eyes, still dazed, and see...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why hello there, guinea pig. You're
awake!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Keep your voice down. For the record,
entering
the premises after hours is
regarded as a violation
of the school's
policies. You wouldn't want to get
in
trouble, would you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Take a guess. No, let me ask you a
question.
What is today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Correct, but not what I was going for. It's
the
holiday season.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
On that note, dear guinea pig, happy
holidays!
Here's a present from me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The presents I've received from her in
the past
have rarely left a good
impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whaaat, you don't like it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I prepared this gift so we could become

psychologically closer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I have my suspicions. But if this gift is
indeed
genuine, I run the risk of
damaging the level of
trust we've built
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open up the packaging to reveal a
small drink
inside.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! One Tachyon-made energy drink,
coming
right up! A sip of this and you'll
be running
marathons!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how you're always so hard at
work, I
thought you might be close to
approaching the
threshold of a burnout.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, what are you waiting for? Bottoms
up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If it's a drink she's concocted, I bet my
body'll end
up glowing a yellow-green
hue or my hair turning
an ocean blue...
Either way, this can't end well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean?! I put in so much
effort too!
The panax ginseng root, for
example, was
procured and delivered all
the way from rural
China!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How disheartening it is to think these
purest
intentions of mine would be met
with rejection.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I suppose this is the result of my past
actions. A
fitting response to the
Umamusume who cried
wolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pained by her dejected frown, I swiftly
down the
bottle, sealing my fate.
choice_data_list: (T-Tachyon has such a sad look on her face...!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I close my eyes in worried anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh, hahahaha! Just how much
longer do
you plan to keep your eyes
shut?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nothing is happening. If anything...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you? It's just an energy
drink. I
wouldn't think of punishing you
on a holiday.
choice_data_list: I feel like my fatigue just melted away...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At least for today, I wanted to express
my
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was that. There is little to be
gained
from further intrusion of your
time. I'll take my
leave and go back to
sleep.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But before I go, you would do well to
look
forward to today's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After saying that, she then exits via the
window.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sweet aftertaste in my mouth
combined with
the winter draft flowing
in, contrary to
expectation, feels quite
pleasant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open up the packaging to reveal a
scented
candle inside.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A scented candle handmade by yours
truly!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's a well established fact that the flame
of a
candle fluctuates at the so-called
1/f frequency.
Not only that, the
candle's fragrance has
therapeutic
effects to both the body and mind.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I specifically chose to incorporate
lavender and
neroli oils, both known for
their calming qualities.
I also added an
infusion of other aromatics to
your
liking, which I took the liberty of
researching
through your private
matters.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, long story short, I'm sure you'll
love the
present! Come on, light it up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I light the scented candle, as per her
request.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Take a whiff, it smells so...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Terrible. It smells kind of sour, savory,
bitter, and
spicy all at the same time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An unbearable smell wafts through the
entire
room!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-ha! My apologies! I had forgotten
to test
it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on, this could be really really
bad! Oh,
that reeks! Tactical retreat! We
have to run,
guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Heh-heh, hehehe—ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's been quite a while since I
panicked!
What a calamitous odor!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I thought I mixed the formula well, but I
suppose I
should avoid things I don't
normally do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Putting aside the resulting mess, she did
try to
make a real present for me. Those
feelings have
been well and truly
conveyed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. As always, you're such a
good-natured
person. As for myself, I'm
beginning to feel a tad
bit queasy.
choice_data_list: The thought alone is more than enough.
The thought alone is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's always frustrating when you set out
to do
something but fall short.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh silly me, I forgot that the expression
of
gratitude isn't limited to tangible
tokens of
appreciation—it can be
articulated in verbal form
as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if a light bulb went on in her head
just now,
she turns and faces me once
again.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Thank you for everything, dear Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This may sound cliché, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She stops mid-sentence and looks away

awkwardly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...W-wait a moment. This is so much
more
embarrassing than I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel that our relationship has gotten
just a bit
closer after being able to see
this rare side of her.
